      "status_by_id": "rc:4147503226",

      "part": 1,
      "type": "suggestion",
      "kind": "approach",
      "text": "use an address from 127.0.0.0/8 with a bogus port instead of relying on -dns=0",

      "text": "avoid real domains entirely rather than relying on other settings like -dns=0",
